strictGoldDefinition: GOLD_STATUS=STRICT_GOLD requires FINAL_AUTHORITY=USER, USER_FINAL_APPROVAL=true, reviewedEntireDocument=true, headingSetExhaustive=true, and unresolvedSemanticUncertainty=false.
finalAuthorityRule: User approval establishes authority; model assistance is truthful provenance only and never disqualifies Strict Gold.

baselineRules.hierarchy: semantic baseline eligibility plus parentEvaluable=true and hierarchyEvaluable=true
baselineRules.notEvaluable: reported on a separate capability denominator; never treated as PASS

historicalModelAssistedRule: The explicitly approved frozen N1.2 reviewed bundle is normalized to STRICT_GOLD with FINAL_AUTHORITY=USER and HUMAN_WITH_MODEL_ASSISTANCE provenance; original silver artifacts and metadata remain unchanged.
activeCohortPolicy: The frozen 15-document DEV cohort is reconciled in place; historical references do not reselection-bias membership.
